agreed_facts.text: Russian strikes hit Kyiv and other parts of Ukraine overnight.
Ukraine says it received no warning or intelligence from allies before Russian strikes.
The United States had threatened to stop sharing intelligence with Ukraine that helps warn of Russian aerial attacks.
The strikes cut power in Kyiv.
People were killed in the strikes.

emphasis.text: Leads with NATO scrambling fighter jets and air alerts on the alliance's eastern flank.
